title: Ericsson meets Gulf demand with NetCloud Private for customer control in Wireless WAN operations
summary: Customer-hosted NetCloud Private addresses a global trend where organizations face regulatory and critical-infrastructure requirements that can restrict the use of public-cloud network management. NetCloud Private delivers scalable lifecycle management for Ericsson Cradlepoint devices to address data residency and operational governance requirements. Network-management and telemetry data remain within the customer-controlled environment, such as an on-premises data center or a trusted in-country cloud.
